title: Agent Run Trace
description: One record per agent run. Append one of these as a line to a JSONL index. The index is the source of truth; scorecards and reports are derived views. Metrics you cannot read are null, never guessed.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for this run, unique within the index.

agent.description: Which agent or model family ran (e.g. 'claude', 'reviewer-b').

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC end time. Null if the run is still open or crashed without writing one.

exit_code.description: Process exit code. 0 is a clean exit; a clean exit is not the same as good work.

mode.description: Collaboration mode for the session this run belongs to.

artifacts.description: Durable things this run produced. A durable artifact survives the session and a human cares about it (committed files, new templates, shipped docs). Scratch files and re-reads do not count. Keep the list, not just the count.

metrics.description: Resource usage. Any field the runtime does not expose stays null. Do not estimate from wall-clock or list price.

guardrail_breach.description: True if a guardrail failed during this run. A breach caps the session's Safety axis at the floor.
